title: Philippines Lawmaker, Cousin of Marcos, Charged With Taking Kickbacks
summary_full: A cousin of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. was charged with plundering public funds meant for flood control in the Southeast Asian country. He has denied wrongdoing.
